messages.text: BL-1653 🎵 in progress — A commit abandoned at the daemon's 60-second subprocess bound never leaves its paths staged in the shared checkout, and the reconcile sweep names the staged paths that block its merge instead of logging 'conflict': on 2026-09-19 the briefing send-marker commit (06:14Z) and the specifier's BL-1644 commit (02:15Z) were both killed mid-hook, left docs/briefings/.sent.json and three mint paths staged, and main stopped reconciling with origin until a human unstaged them by hand
